modelspec.data.VocabularySize.title: VocabularySize
modelspec.data.VocabularySize.description: The number of tokens of a vocabulary, V, more than the five special tokens, so a random substitution has a token in [5, V) to draw; the type of PackedDataset.vocabulary_size, so the generated JSON Schema carries the bound as `minimum` 6 (story:content-hash-schema-constrained; coordinator decision D34, 2026-10-25, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).
